habitual_practice.description: Authorised discharges are organised at the habitual hour: transport requested then, departure when ready and transport available. Cleaning first-in-first-out with the cleaning team. Admissions first-in-first-out on the first clean compatible bed. Roster only, no reinforcement. Planned departures are kept as planned. This is NOT 'do nothing': care, arrivals and ordinary decisions continue.
